topics.title: Howard Stern Interviews Steve and Jessica at the Playboy Mansion
topics.summary: During a live broadcast, Howard Stern interviews Steve Rossi and his son while discussing Jessica Hahn’s appearance. The conversation quickly devolved into crude remarks about physical attributes and sexual encounters, with participants making inappropriate comments regarding breasts and sexual experiences. A Spanish-speaking duo also joined the discussion, contributing to the program's explicit nature.

topics.title: Steve’s Tennis & Eccentric Guests
topics.summary: During the radio show, Steve discusses his private tennis partner, Engelbert Humberdane, and frequently calls him ‘Enge.’ He also mentions regular visitors like Jack Carter (playing golf) and Marty Allen, leading to humorous exchanges about their odd behaviors and a brief discussion of Nancy Reagan’s political views.”} iefly.

topics.title: Family Troubles and Radio Frustrations
topics.summary: Joel Steinberg grapples with his family history, including Jane Wyman, while expressing dissatisfaction with syndicated radio company ‘Radio Today.’ Legal issues surrounding Hedda Nussbaum’s alleged fraud continue to be discussed alongside Eddie Murphy previewing a CBS television pilot featuring musical artist performances.

topics.title: Howard Discusses Antigua Vacation & Tom’s Interference
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Howard recounts his vacation in Antigua with his wife, including an unusual incident involving a vibrator and friendly black people. He also expresses frustration over program director decisions and Tom's persistent attempts to join the show.

topics.title: Stern Accuses Imus & Rosenberg of Theft
topics.summary: Howard Stern criticizes Don Imus for copying one of his bits about Lucie Ball after her death and accuses Al Rosenberg of utilizing the same material. He expresses frustration with this pattern of intellectual property theft within the radio industry, highlighting a competitive dynamic among personalities.

topics.title: Radio Show - Ray D.O. Fan & Listener Chaos
topics.summary: During a radio show, hosts discuss vacation exhaustion and bizarre musical snippets created by intern Ray D.O. Fan, including extended Bon Jovi songs about nail polish and gynecological exams. A former New Yorker, Gary attempts to promote his healing abilities while discussing potential talent scouts, leading to increasingly absurd conversations and listener calls.
